items.gold_nlq: What is the DLC key, name of the DLC, total number of floors, total square footage, total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, total number of supervisees, and total building heights for each DLC?
items.gold_sql: SELECT su.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS Total_Number_Of_Floors, sd.Total_Square_Footage, COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Total_Number_Facility, COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS Total_Supervisors, SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS Total_Supervisees, SUM(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS Cumulative_Building_Height FROM (SELECT SPACE_DETAIL.*, SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_COMPONENT) AS Total_Square_Footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL) sd JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT DLC_KEY, DLC_NAME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION) fo ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY su.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, sd.Total_Square_Footage;

iterations.nlq: What is the DLC key, name of the DLC, total number of floors, total square footage, total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, total number of supervisees, and total building heights for each DLC?
iterations.generated_sql:
WITH dlc_base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    fo.DLC_NAME
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY
),
space_agg AS (
  SELECT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS total_floors,
    SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_facility_organizations,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT IS NULL OR TRIM(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) = '' THEN 0
          ELSE CAST(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        END) AS total_building_heights
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd
    ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY su.DLC_KEY
),
supervisor_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ssu.DEPT_NAMES AS DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS total_supervisors,
    SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
  FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
  GROUP BY ssu.DEPT_NAMES
)
SELECT
  b.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key,
  b.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name,
  COALESCE(sa.total_floors, 0) AS total_number_of_floors,
  COALESCE(sa.total_square_footage, 0) AS total_square_footage,
  COALESCE(sa.total_facility_organizations, 0) AS total_number_of_facility_organizations,
  COALESCE(sva.total_supervisors, 0) AS total_number_of_supervisors,
  COALESCE(sva.total_supervisees, 0) AS total_number_of_supervisees,
  COALESCE(sa.total_building_heights, 0) AS total_building_heights
FROM dlc_base b
LEFT JOIN space_agg sa
  ON sa.DLC_KEY = b.DLC_KEY
LEFT JOIN supervisor_agg sva
  ON sva.DLC_KEY = b.DLC_KEY
ORDER BY b.DLC_KEY;

iterations.nlq: For each DLC, list the DLC key and DLC name, along with (a) the count of distinct floor numbers, (b) the total square footage computed as the sum of room square footage within each building component, (c) the count of distinct facility organization keys, (d) the count of distinct supervisors, (e) the total number of supervisees, and (f) the cumulative sum of building heights. Return one row per combination of DLC and that building-component-level total square footage.
iterations.generated_sql:
SELECT
  su.DLC_KEY,
  fo.DLC_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS total_floors,
  sd.total_sqft,
  COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_facility_orgs,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS total_supervisors,
  SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees,
  SUM(CAST(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS cumulative_building_height
FROM (
  SELECT
    sd.*,
    SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT) AS total_sqft
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
) sd
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
  ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
  ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
  ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
  ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    DLC_KEY,
    DLC_NAME
  FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION
) fo
  ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY
GROUP BY
  su.DLC_KEY,
  fo.DLC_NAME,
  sd.total_sqft;
